episodeTitle.en: What it takes to become a top 1% PM | Ian McAllister (Uber, Amazon, Airbnb)
episodeTitle.zh: 成为顶级1%产品经理需要具备哪些条件 | 伊恩·麦卡利斯特（曾任Uber、亚马逊、Airbnb高管）

guestBioOfficial.en: Ian McAllister is the Senior Director of Product for Vehicles at Uber. Before moving to Uber, Ian spent over a decade directing teams at Amazon, where he created and led Amazon Smile. He was also Director of Product Management at Airbnb, where I was lucky enough to have worked alongside him. In today’s episode, we discuss Ian’s famous document about the essential attributes of the top 1% of product managers. Ian outlines the most important skills to focus on for entry-level PMs and how to broaden your experience and diversify skills as you move up the ladder. He also shares what he learned working with Jeff Wilke, Jeff Bezos, and other leaders at Amazon, and goes in depth on Amazon’s working-backwards framework.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 伊恩·麦卡利斯特是Uber的车辆产品高级总监。在加入Uber之前，伊恩在亚马逊工作了十多年，期间他创建并领导了亚马逊Smile项目。他还曾在Airbnb担任产品管理总监，我有幸与他共事过。今天的节目中，我们将探讨伊恩关于顶级1%产品经理必备特质的著名文档。伊恩概述了入门级PM应关注的最重要技能，以及如何在晋升过程中拓宽经验、多元化技能。他还分享了在亚马逊与杰夫·威尔克、杰夫·贝索斯及其他领导层合作的经验，并深入解读亚马逊的逆向工作法框架。

title.en: What it takes to become a top 1% PM | Ian McAllister (Uber, Amazon, Airbnb)
title.zh: 成为顶级1%产品经理需要具备哪些条件 | 伊恩·麦卡利斯特（曾任Uber、亚马逊、Airbnb高管）

summary.en: Ian centers his advice on impact—if you wake up trying to maximize impact rather than politics or promotions, that's the guiding light—and breaks down precisely what separates a top 1% PM from everyone else, for both new and senior PMs. He then goes deep on Amazon's 'working backwards' process: how to implement it on your team, and the common ways teams do it wrong. The episode is a must-listen for PMs at any level, with linked templates and guides in the show notes.
summary.zh: Ian 把建议聚焦于“影响力”——如果你每天醒来都想最大化影响力，而非钻营政治或升职，那就是指路明灯，并精准拆解了前 1% 的 PM 究竟有何不同，分别对初级和高级 PM 都适用。接着他深入亚马逊的“逆向工作”（working backwards）流程：如何在团队落地，以及团队常犯的错误。这期节目是任何层级 PM 的必听内容，节目附注中还附上了相关模板与指南链接。
